extra.implementerRules:
- Every user-facing change adds or updates an analytics event, and the tests assert it.
- UI: WCAG 2.2 AA, semantic elements, labels, keyboard and focus; CSS variables for every color, spacing and layout value (no hardcoded values). Match the neighboring CSS module.
- Match the conventions of neighboring files (schemas, forms, hooks, service modules). Do not add a new library or pattern without an ADR.
extra.docsDuties: - New pages: add the route to the sitemap files (`public/sitemap.xml` and any sitemap index the project keeps).
